source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-6

procedures.title: Headlamp housing (panel) alignment
steps: (Continued) Pull the cotter pin from the rod pin.
With the engine idling to supply vacuum, turn the actuator rod until the bushing hole lines up with the front end of the slot in the connecting link (extended position).
Stop the engine, retract the actuator rod and back the rod out 1/2 turn to preload it in the link.
Up (bezel to opening): loosen the jam nut and run the rubber-covered bumper screw up or down until it touches, then turn it 1-1/2 more turns up.
notes: Align the headlamp housing before aiming the headlamps.
